This phone\'s key is locked by a key in StrongBox, the phone\'s security chip, which opens it only for your fingerprint, once for each unlock. While an unlock is under way the key is in this app\'s memory, and traces of it can stay there afterwards.

This phone has no secure hardware that will hold the key that locks this phone\'s key, so that key is only as safe as the phone itself. You have allowed that on this phone. Anything with root access to the phone could read it, and your fingerprint would not stop that.
This phone has no secure hardware for the key

The key that locks synctang\'s key could only be made in software, not in the phone\'s secure hardware. Anything with root access to the phone could read it, and your fingerprint would not stop that. synctang will not use it unless you allow it.

This phone now has a new key, and the old one is gone. Pair with the machine again. On the machine, revoke this phone\'s old device ID, %1$s, with synctang-unlocker enrol --remove.
This phone\'s key refused the fingerprint it was given, so nothing was sent to the machine. Try again. If the key was invalidated, the next attempt will say so and make a new one.

This phone\'s key stopped working because the fingerprints or faces enrolled on the phone, or its screen lock, changed, and the machine was not answered. The phone now has a new key: pair with the machine again. On the machine, revoke this phone\'s old device ID, %1$s, with synctang-unlocker enrol --remove.
